en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed a session with a damaged `.claude.json` failing every later start under `--trust-workspace false`; it now starts on defaults, with MCP servers turned off there on again
zh: 自托管运行器：修复了 `.claude.json` 损坏的 session 在 `--trust-workspace false` 下每次后续启动都失败的问题；现在它会以默认配置启动，并在该处重新关闭 MCP server
